results.title: Letter: Missouri officials show contempt for voters with map controversy
results.description: Over 300,000 Missouri citizens signed a petition to put an initiative on the ballot to repeal the legislature's recent gerrymandered electoral map. The Supreme Court has twice refused to overturn a lower court ruling that the map is unconstitutional.

results.title: Cooper appoints ‘strong and capable’ CQC chair
results.description: The health secretary has named Baroness Julia Neuberger as the Care Quality Commission’s new chair, after MPs said they believed she would be “strong and capable”.
